en: Tinted vintage postcard view of a canal in Bruges with several white swans resting on a tree‑lined bank in the foreground. Across the water stands a row of traditional stepped‑gabled houses with red and brown roofs, reflected in the calm canal. The image has a hand‑colored look typical of early 20th‑century postcards. Printed text at the top reads a caption identifying the scene and publisher information.
